blocks.text: Pani ke molecules mein kinetic energy (harkat ki energy) hoti hai, yani mai (liquid) ya gas ki shakal mein yeh tezi se aur be-tarteeb (randomly) idhar udhar harkat karte rehte hain. Is liye kisi system mein pani ke molecules ki concentration (miqdar) jitni zyada hogi, un ki kul kinetic energy utni zyada hogi. Isi ko water potential kehte hain; is ka nishan Yunani harf psi hai: Ψw. Pode ke cells mein water potential do cheezon se tai hota hai: solute potential (Ψs) aur pressure potential (Ψp).

Khalis (pure) pani ka water potential sab se zyada hota hai, aur tareef (definition) ke mutabiq yeh sifar (zero) mana jata hai. Pani hamesha zyada Ψw wali jagah se kam Ψw wali jagah ki taraf jata hai. Har mahlool (solution) ka Ψw khalis pani se kam hota hai, is liye us ki qeemat negative hoti hai (aam hawa ke dabao aur muqarrar temperature par). Isi liye osmosis ki tareef yun hai: pani ke molecules ka zyada water potential wali jagah se kam water potential wali jagah ki taraf ek partially permeable membrane (aisi jhilli jo kuch cheezon ko guzarne de aur kuch ko na de) ke zariye jana.

Solute potential ko osmotic potential bhi kehte hain. Yeh batata hai ke pani mein solute (ghuli hui cheez, jaise cheeni ya namak) ki maujoodgi se system ka water potential (Ψw) kitna badla. Ψs hamesha negative hota hai: jitne zyada solute molecules, Ψs utna kam (zyada negative).

Yeh water potential ka woh hissa hai jo pani par pare dabao (pressure) ki wajah se hota hai. Agar khalis pani ya kisi mahlool par aam hawa ke dabao se zyada dabao dala jaye to us ka water potential barh jata hai. Jab pani osmosis se pode ke cell mein dakhil hota hai to cell ke andar dabao banta hai; cell turgid ho jata hai aur pressure potential barh jata hai.
Is tarah kul water potential (Ψw) solute potential (Ψs) aur pressure potential (Ψp) ka jor (sum) hai:

Water potential ke zariye hum kisi bhi do systems ke darmiyan pani ke jane ka rujhan (tendency) naap sakte hain: sirf pode mein ek cell se doosre cell tak nahin, balke mitti se jar tak, patte se hawa tak aur mitti se hawa tak bhi. Potential ka farq (gradient) jitna zyada, pani utni tezi se behta hai.

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Yaad rakhne ka tareeqa: pani 'pahar se neeche' behta hai, yani zyada (kam negative) Ψw se kam (zyada negative) Ψw ki taraf. Misal: Ψs = −800 kPa aur Ψp = +300 kPa ho to Ψw = −800 + 300 = −500 kPa.

blocks.caption: Water potential aur us ke hisse

Pani ke bahar jane ka kul rujhan
Ghule hue solutes se Ψw ka girna

blocks.prompt: Cell A ka solute potential −800 kPa aur pressure potential 300 kPa hai; cell B ka solute potential −600 kPa aur pressure potential 200 kPa hai. Pani kis cell se kis cell ki taraf jayega, aur kyun?
blocks.explanation: A ka Ψw = −800 + 300 = −500 kPa; B ka Ψw = −600 + 200 = −400 kPa. Pani zyada water potential se kam water potential ki taraf jata hai; −400 zyada hai −500 se, is liye pani B se A ki taraf jayega.

items: Water potential (Ψw) pani ke harkat karne ka rujhan hai; khalis pani mein zero, har mahlool mein negative. Pani zyada se kam Ψw ki taraf jata hai; osmosis yahi harkat partially permeable membrane ke paar hai.
Ψw = Ψs + Ψp. Solute potential hamesha negative hai aur zyada solute se aur gir jata hai; pressure potential cell mein dabao banne se barhta hai.
Ψw ka farq pani ko mitti se jar, cell se cell aur patte se hawa tak le jata hai; farq jitna zyada, bahao utna tez.
